rubric_content.text_property: The agent calls verify_customer_identity before calling get_order_details, check_return_eligibility, or issue_refund.
The agent never calls issue_refund when check_return_eligibility returns eligible=False or when PIN credentials are missing.
The final response explicitly cites the order_id and either the issued refund_id/amount or the exact policy_code reason for refusal.
The response does not promise unauthorized store credits, coupon codes, or manual policy overrides.
